name: Scalelist API
description:
Find verified work emails and direct mobile numbers for the people you want to reach.

Every lookup runs through a waterfall of specialist data providers, reaching for a paid source only when the cheaper ones come up empty. **You are charged only when we find something.**

## What you can do

- **Find an email** from a name and a company.
- **Find a mobile number** from a LinkedIn URL, an email, or a name and a company.
- **Find emails at a company**, with no names needed.
- **Search for people** by title, seniority, industry and location.

Each of these runs one at a time, or in bulk up to 100 per call with results delivered by webhook or polling.

## Getting started

1. Sign in to your [Scalelist account](https://app.scalelist.com/auth/login).
2. Create an API key on the [API keys page](https://app.scalelist.com/app/api-key).
3. Send it as the `x-api-key` header on every request:

```http
POST /email/find/single
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

A missing or unrecognised key returns `401`; a malformed body returns `400` or `422`.

## Using this API from an LLM or coding agent

This whole reference is also published as one plain-markdown file at [`/llms.txt`](/llms.txt). One fetch, with no JavaScript to render and no pages to crawl. It is generated from this same specification on every request, so it can never fall behind the endpoints below.
